data.rationale: Keeps local and online models constrained to app-owned source reconstruction across supported languages including Romanian.
data.requirement: Narrator-and-character Speech Blocks prompts shall use the multilingual source-span selection contract only, include the active source language, prohibit translation or rewritten final text, require allowed `source_span_ids` only, and return JSON-only `blocks`.
data.verification: Automated pytest verifies multilingual source-span Speech Blocks prompt contract.

data.rationale: Improves speaker attribution for multilingual local models while preventing halo text from being selected into saved Speech Blocks.
data.requirement: Speech Blocks prompt rendering shall expose source-language character names and aliases in the allowed speaker catalog and include previous/next chunk halo text only as non-selectable attribution context, never as selectable source spans.
data.verification: Automated pytest verifies character aliases and source-language evidence are present in Speech Blocks prompt catalogs.

data.rationale: Speech Blocks quality depends on upstream operations preserving the text structure that span selection and speaker attribution consume.
data.requirement: Adjacent text cleanup, translation, and chunking prompt guidance shall preserve multilingual dialogue punctuation, paragraph shape, and nearby attribution needed by Speech Blocks source-span selection.
data.verification: Automated pytest verifies adjacent cleanup, translation, and chunking prompts preserve dialogue punctuation and attribution context for Speech Blocks.

data.rationale: Keeps operator guidance honest about what the app controls and prevents unsupported sampler settings from appearing in AudioMancer AI Settings.
data.requirement: AudioMancer local-model guidance shall state that AI Settings sends only request-level model, context, max-output, temperature, timeout, and structured-output hints to LM Studio, while sampler controls such as top-p, top-k, repeat penalty, seed, and reasoning mode remain LM Studio preset settings unless provider payload support is intentionally added.
data.verification: Automated pytest verifies docs describe AudioMancer request settings versus LM Studio-only sampler and reasoning presets.
